analysis.rationale: Revenue and PAT grew strongly by 34.8% and 72.4% respectively, with EPS rising to Rs. 8.58 from Rs. 5.04. The company also raised funds via preferential issue and converted warrants, strengthening capital structure.
analysis.summary: Precision Wires India reported FY2025-26 revenue of Rs. 541,018.05 lakhs (up 34.8% YoY) and PAT of Rs. 15,526.80 lakhs (up 72.4% YoY), with EPS of Rs. 8.58 and total dividend of Rs. 1.25 per share.
